basic_info.description: Trophy 5-unit building in the sunny Mission District, on an extra-large lot, exudes pride of ownership and offers excellent opportunities for investors and owner-users alike. Two remodeled upper flats are large, well lighted, and each offers two remodeled bathrooms, a remodeled kitchen, in-unit laundry, dining room and four other rooms for use as bedrooms, living or office space. Period charm remains, with tall ceilings, wainscoting and hardwood floors. One of these upper units will be delivered vacant. Two lower units offer similar floor plans, similar period charm and with one less room, and one less bathroom. One of these lower units will be delivered vacant. The fifth unit was added to the rear of the garage, is about 9 years old and offers two bedrooms, one with en-suite bathroom, a second bathroom and a modern, open kitchen/living/dining area. When the 5th unit was added, the building underwent extensive seismic upgrades including new foundation and slab, moment frame and a sprinklered ground floor. Electrical systems are updated, the rear yard is mature and welcoming, with a bountiful avocado tree, and there are two large garage spaces, and storage cupboards for each tenant.
